import_compatibility.note_ar: لم تُرفق مواصفات استيراد AYLA. هذه صيغة JSON عامة للتصنيف، ولا تضمن الاستيراد المباشر إلى AYLA؛ قد تحتاج إلى مواءمة الحقول وفق مواصفات النظام.

source.title: Dewhurst’s Textbook of Obstetrics & Gynaecology
source.page_numbering: One-based physical page positions in the supplied PDF; not print-edition page numbers.
source.extraction_scope: All entries under Table of Contents, ending at End User License Agreement and stopping before List of Tables on PDF page 23.
source.scope_note_ar: الملف يحفظ فهرس المحتويات الكامل في النسخة المرفقة، بما فيه المقدمات والمراجع والخواتيم والملاحق المدرجة. لا يشمل تفريغ الفهرس الأبجدي الخلفي أو قوائم الأشكال والجداول، ولا يدّعي استخراج كل العناوين الداخلية غير المذكورة بفهرس المحتويات.
source.text_handling: Original English titles, capitalization and punctuation retained. Tabs/repeated spaces and wrapped lines are joined; a line break after a hyphen is joined without inserting a space. No translation or editorial correction is applied. Visible U+2010 hyphens are retained, and differing bookmark spellings are recorded separately.

title_origin_values.source: The title is transcribed from the supplied PDF table of contents.
title_origin_values.inferred: An editorially supplied title; no such title is introduced in this file.

classification_origin_values.inferred_mapping: Editorial mapping of an existing source heading to the requested bank level. This is not a claim that the book uses AYLA field names.

mapping_rules.reason: Use the two source Sections as the two Subjects, retaining their exact titles.
Keep the 70 numbered book chapters as Chapters. Parts remain source group metadata rather than adding a fifth taxonomy level.
Map each heading directly listed under a chapter in the source contents to Topic, without inventing deeper grouping.

classification_policy.parts_preservation: All 17 original Parts remain in source_contents.entries and are linked from every chapter through source_part.

subtopic_policy.action: Every Topic contains an empty subtopics array.
subtopic_policy.note_ar: لا يعرض فهرس المحتويات مستوى فرعياً تحت العناوين داخل الفصول؛ لذلك تُرك Subtopic فارغاً، دون اختلاق عناوين أو استنتاج تقسيمات سريرية.

classification_policy.non_clinical_heading_policy: Retain headings such as References, Further reading, Summary and Acknowledgements exactly where the full source contents lists them. They are not omitted or silently relabelled.
